parameters.description: Words a Part must hold, in any order and any case, in its name, its manufacturer or a part number. Left out or empty, every Visible Part of the Category is found.

parameters.description: Manufacturers, repeated for several: a Part of any of them is found. Left out, a Part of any manufacturer is.

parameters.name: lowest
parameters.description: The price range's lowest end, in whole ones of the chosen currency, whole dollars or whole dinars, compared with each Lowest Price as answered and included. Given, a Part with no Lowest Price is left out. Refused when it is above the highest end.

parameters.name: highest
parameters.description: The price range's highest end, in whole ones of the chosen currency, compared with each Lowest Price as answered and included. Given, a Part with no Lowest Price is left out.

parameters.name: inStockOnly
parameters.description: In stock only, as the picker lists a Category (BLD-2): on, only the Visible Parts with at least one in-stock Visible Offer are listed, in the same order.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: The Build so far, as the picker lists a Category for it (BLD-3), taken as reading a Build takes it. Given, each Part answers whether it is Compatible with it. Left out, no Part answers it, as on a Category page. Each value is a Part's identifier, followed for a RAM kit or a drive by `:` and its quantity, a whole number from 1 to 16 in Western digits, repeated for each Part. A Part the catalog does not hold is left out of the Build. Refused, naming `part`, for a value that is not an identifier; a quantity on a Part that is not a RAM kit or a drive, or none on one that is; a quantity outside 1 to 16; two Parts of a Category a Build holds one of; one Part given twice; and more than 8 different RAM kits, or more than 8 different drives.

parameters.name: keepNotCompatible
parameters.description: The picker's switch (BLD-3): on, the Parts that are not Compatible with the Build are kept, in their place in the order, each answering that it is not. Off, they are left out. It changes nothing without a Build.

parameters.name: socket
parameters.description: A filter: for CPUs, the Socket at `socket`; for motherboards, the Socket at `socket`. Repeated for several values, a Part holding any of them is found, and a Part missing it is not. Refused for any other Category.

parameters.name: cores
parameters.description: A filter: for CPUs, the Cores at `cores.total`. Repeated for several values, a Part holding any of them is found, and a Part missing it is not. Refused for any other Category.

parameters.name: ramType

parameters.name: capacity

usdPrice.description: The Quoted Price in USD, as a decimal number in Western digits, with at most two decimal places, more than 0 and at most 100000.00. It or the IQD price, or both, must be given.

iqdPrice.description: The Quoted Price in IQD, in whole dinars, more than 0 and at most 150000000. It or the USD price, or both, must be given.

inStock.description: Whether the Vendor has the Part in stock now.

warrantyMonths.description: The warranty, in whole months from 1 to 120, or null when the Vendor states none.

amount.description: The amount, as decimal text: in USD with two decimal places, in IQD in whole dinars. A Quoted Price is as the Vendor entered it; a Converted Price is rounded to the nearest 250 IQD or whole dollar, and is never below one step.

converted.description: Whether it is a Converted Price, derived from the Offer's Quoted Price in the other currency at the current Platform Rate, which a Shopper sees marked "≈".

id.description: The Vendor's identifier on the platform.

name.description: The Vendor's name, as the Vendor writes it.

usdPrice.description: The Quoted Price in USD, as a decimal number with two decimal places, or null when the Vendor quotes none.

iqdPrice.description: The Quoted Price in IQD, in whole dinars, or null when the Vendor quotes none.

shownPrice.description: The price the Offer shows in the chosen currency: its Quoted Price in that currency if there is one, else its Converted Price. Null only when the Offer has no Quoted Price in the chosen currency and no Platform Rate has been set.

inStock.description: Whether the Vendor has the Part in stock.

warrantyMonths.description: The warranty, in whole months, or null when the Vendor states none.

confirmedAt.description: When the Vendor last confirmed the Offer.

daysSinceConfirmation.description: The whole days of 24 hours since the last Confirmation, rounded down: 0 on the day it was confirmed.

id.description: The Part's identifier on the platform.

photoPath.description: The address of the Part's photo on this API, or null when it has none.

lowestPrice.description: The Lowest Price: the lowest Shown Price among the Part's in-stock Visible Offers, in the chosen currency, as the first of them a Part's page lists shows it, marked converted exactly when that Offer's is. Null when no Visible Offer is in stock, and when none in stock has a Shown Price, which happens only when no Platform Rate has been set.

vendorCount.description: How many Vendors have a Visible Offer for the Part, in stock or not.

inStock.description: Whether any Visible Offer for the Part is in stock. False when every Vendor has it out of stock.

compatible.description: Whether the Part is Compatible with the Build the list was asked for: adding it would cause no Compatibility Problem, a Compatibility Warning and an unchecked rule leaving it Compatible (CMP-4). Left out when the list was asked for without a Build.

pageSize.description: How many items a page holds.

totalElements.description: How many items were found, on all the pages together.

first.description: Whether this is the first page.

last.description: Whether this is the last page, or past it.

content.description: The page's Visible Parts: those with a Lowest Price first, the lowest first; then those in stock with none; then those every Vendor has out of stock; then by name.

compatibleCount.description: With a Build, how many of the Parts the list judged are Compatible with it, on all the pages together: those that the search, the manufacturers, the filters, the price range and in stock only keep, read in the same statement as the page. Left out when the list was asked for without a Build.

notCompatibleCount.description: With a Build, how many of the Parts the list judged are not Compatible with it, on all the pages together, whether or not the switch keeps them, read in the same statement as the page. Left out when the list was asked for without a Build.

FilterKind.description: The kind of value it offers: a whole number, text, or yes or no.

parameter.description: The parameter a Category's list of Visible Parts is narrowed by it with, repeated for several values.

kind.description: The kind of value it offers: a whole number, text, or yes or no.

values.description: The distinct values the Visible Parts hold, numbers by size and text alphabetically, as a Part's specifications hold them: never one that stands for "not known".

lowest.description: The lowest of the Visible Parts' Lowest Prices, as decimal text, as a Lowest Price's amount is. Null when none has a Lowest Price.

highest.description: The highest of the Visible Parts' Lowest Prices, as decimal text. Null when none has a Lowest Price.

filters.description: The Category's filters that some Visible Part holds a value of, in the order a form shows them, each with its values.

priceRange.description: The range of the Visible Parts' Lowest Prices.

path.description: The specification's place in a Part's specifications, in OpenDB's field names and nesting, as its Category's specification list names it. For a field of a row, its name in the row.

kind.description: The kind of value it holds, which says how to show it.

unit.description: The unit of a number, or null when it has none.

value.description: What the Part holds: a number, in the unit; a text; true or false, for yes or no; a list of texts, for a choice of several or a list of text; or, for a list of rows, each row as the list of the fields it holds, answered as a specification is, and no rows when the Part has none.

id.description: The Part's identifier on the platform.

photoPath.description: The address of the Part's photo on this API, or null when it has none.

specifications.description: The specifications the Part holds, in the order of its Category's specification list, each with its English label and unit. One it lacks is left out, and so is a 0 where 0 stands for "not known".

usdPrice.description: The Quoted Price in USD, as a decimal number with two decimal places, or null when the Vendor quotes none.

iqdPrice.description: The Quoted Price in IQD, in whole dinars, or null when the Vendor quotes none.

shownPrice.description: The price the Offer shows in the chosen currency: its Quoted Price in that currency if there is one, else its Converted Price. Null only when the Offer has no Quoted Price in the chosen currency and no Platform Rate has been set.

inStock.description: Whether the Vendor has the Part in stock.

warrantyMonths.description: The warranty, in whole months, or null when the Vendor states none.

confirmedAt.description: When the Vendor last confirmed the Offer.

daysSinceConfirmation.description: The whole days of 24 hours since the last Confirmation, rounded down: 0 on the day it was confirmed.

pageSize.description: How many items a page holds.

totalElements.description: How many items were found, on all the pages together.

first.description: Whether this is the first page.

last.description: Whether this is the last page, or past it.

content.description: The page's Offers, grouped by their Parts' Categories in the catalog's order, and within each Category in stock first, then the lowest Shown Price, with Offers that have none after the others, then the most recent Confirmation, then the Part's name.

activeVendorCount.description: How many active Vendors the platform has, one with no Visible Offer among them. A deactivated Vendor is not counted.

visibleOfferCount.description: How many Visible Offers the platform lists, in stock or not: Offers that are not Expired Offers, of active Vendors.

iqdPerUsd.description: The current Platform Rate, in whole dinars per dollar, or null until the Admin sets the first.

daysAnOfferStaysCurrent.description: How many days an Offer stays current without a Confirmation: one last confirmed longer ago is an Expired Offer, which no Shopper sees.

part.description: The Part that lacks it, by its identifier.

path.description: Its path in the Part's specifications, in OpenDB's field names and nesting, as its Category's specification list names it; for a field of a row, the list's path, the row's place from 0 and the field's name.

label.description: Its English label, from the Part's specification list; for a field of a row, the list's.

fieldLabel.description: For a field of a row, such as a PCIe slot's lanes, the field's English label; null otherwise.

parts.description: The Parts it is about, by their identifiers: for a Compatibility Problem or a Warning, the Parts whose values make it, every RAM kit or drive it counts among them; for a pass, every Part the rule judged; none for an unchecked rule. In the catalog's order of Categories, and the RAM kits and drives in the Build's order.

missing.description: For an unchecked rule, each needed specification a Part lacks that could change its outcome, once, in the catalog's order of the Parts; none otherwise.

rule.description: The rule's number, as the MVP spec numbers them: one of the rules that can give a Compatibility Warning, from the compatibility library's own list.

outcome.description: Its outcome: `passes`; `problem`, a Compatibility Problem; `warning`, a Compatibility Warning; or `unchecked`, when a needed specification it reads is missing and could change it. An unchecked rule is never a pass.

parts.description: The Parts it is about, by their identifiers: for a Compatibility Problem or a Warning, the Parts whose values make it, every RAM kit or drive it counts among them; for a pass, every Part the rule judged; none for an unchecked rule. In the catalog's order of Categories, and the RAM kits and drives in the Build's order.

missing.description: For an unchecked rule, each needed specification a Part lacks that could change its outcome, once, in the catalog's order of the Parts; none otherwise.

rule.description: The rule's number, as the MVP spec numbers them: one of the rules that never give a Compatibility Warning, from the compatibility library's own list.

outcome.description: Its outcome: `passes`; `problem`, a Compatibility Problem; or `unchecked`, when a needed specification it reads is missing and could change it. An unchecked rule is never a pass.

shownPrice.description: The Lowest Price of one of the Part: the lowest Shown Price among its in-stock Visible Offers, in the chosen currency, as the first of them a Part's page lists shows it, marked converted exactly when that Offer's is.

timesQuantity.description: The Lowest Price times the Part's quantity, as the total across Vendors adds it up: the same as the Lowest Price for a Part of a Category a Build holds one of.

vendor.description: The Vendor whose Offer the Lowest Price comes from: of equal prices, the one whose Offer the Part page lists first.

id.description: The Part's identifier on the platform.

photoPath.description: The address of the Part's photo on this API, or null when it has none.

quantity.description: How many of it the Build holds, from 1 to 16, for a RAM kit or a drive; null for a Part of a Category a Build holds one of.

visible.description: Whether it is a Visible Part, a Part with at least one Visible Offer, which a Part page shows. A Part that is not stays in the Build.

unstocked.description: Whether it is an Unstocked Part: no Vendor has it in stock among its Visible Offers, whether or not it is still a Visible Part (BLD-9). It stays in the Build, has no Lowest Price, is left out of every total and is in no Vendor's list.

priceNotShown.description: Whether some Vendor has it in stock but its price could not be shown: the first of its in-stock Visible Offers has no Shown Price, which happens only before the first Platform Rate, with an Offer quoted only in the other currency. It then has no Lowest Price, and is left out of the total across Vendors.

lowestPrice.description: Its Lowest Price in the chosen currency, times its quantity, with the Vendor it comes from, which the total across Vendors adds up (BLD-7). Null for an Unstocked Part, and for a Part whose price could not be shown.

watts.description: What the Build is reckoned to draw, in W: its CPU's TDP, plus its GPU's TDP when it has one, plus 100 W for everything else. Null when a TDP it needs is missing.

missing.description: Each TDP the draw needs that its Part lacks, the CPU's before the GPU's; none when the watts are known.

partId.description: The Part's identifier, as the Build's Parts name it.

shownPrice.description: The Vendor's Shown Price for one of the Part, in the chosen currency. Null only when its Offer has no Quoted Price in the chosen currency and no Platform Rate has been set: the Part is then left out of the Vendor's total.

timesQuantity.description: The Shown Price times the Part's quantity, as the Vendor's total adds it up, or null with it.

id.description: The Vendor's identifier on the platform.

name.description: The Vendor's name, as the Vendor writes it.

hasWhatsAppNumber.description: Whether the Vendor gave a WhatsApp number, so that a page offers to send the Build to it only where a chat can be opened. The number itself is answered by recording a Referral.

total.description: The Vendor's total: each Shown Price of the Parts it has in stock times its quantity, added up as answered, after rounding, marked converted when any of them is a Converted Price. Null when none of them has a Shown Price, which happens only when no Platform Rate has been set.

partsInStock.description: The Build's Parts the Vendor has in stock among its Visible Offers, in the order of the Build's Parts.

partsLacked.description: The identifiers of the Build's Parts that other Vendors have in stock and this one does not, in the order of the Build's Parts. An Unstocked Part is never among them.

parts.description: The Build's Parts that the catalog holds, in the catalog's order of Categories, and the RAM kits and drives in the order the Build gives them. A Part the catalog no longer holds is left out.

complete.description: Whether it is a Complete Build: a CPU, a motherboard, at least one RAM kit, at least one drive, a case and a PSU, with a GPU unless the CPU has integrated graphics and a CPU cooler unless the CPU includes one.

stillNeeded.description: The Categories it still needs, in the catalog's order: none for a Complete Build, and all eight for an empty one.

cpuValuesNotKnown.description: The values of the Build's CPU that the rule for a Complete Build reads and the CPU does not hold: `integratedGraphics`, its Integrated graphics, and `includesCooler`, its Cooler included. A CPU that does not hold one counts as not providing it, so the GPU or the CPU cooler stays needed. None without a CPU.

outcomes.description: The outcome of every Compatibility Rule that applies to the Build, passes included, in rule order, each of a rule of the compatibility library's own list and as its rule can have it: a Compatibility Warning only of a rule that can give one. A rule applies only when the Build holds a Part of each Category it involves (CMP-2), so an empty Build has none. Every Part is judged, one that is no longer a Visible Part and one no Vendor has in stock among them, since each stays in the Build.

estimatedPowerDraw.description: Its Estimated power draw, as the Compatibility Rules add it up, or the TDPs it lacks; null for a Build without a CPU.

totalAcrossVendors.description: The first price view's total, the Build's total across Vendors (BLD-7, PRC-5): each Part's Lowest Price times its quantity, added up as answered, after rounding, marked converted when any of them is a Converted Price. It leaves out each Part with no Lowest Price, and is null when no Part has one.

vendors.description: The second price view (BLD-8): each active Vendor with at least one of the Build's Parts in stock among its Visible Offers, with its total, the Parts it has and the Parts it lacks. They come by how many Parts they lack, fewest first, then by their total, lowest first, with none after any, then by name, then by identifier. An Unstocked Part is in no Vendor's list.

iqdPerUsd.description: The Platform Rate, in whole dinars per dollar.

current.description: The current Platform Rate, the newest setting, or null until the Admin sets the first.

iqdPerUsd.description: The Platform Rate, in whole dinars per dollar, as a JSON whole number within the platform's limits.

part.description: The Build to share, as `GET v1/build` takes it. Each value is a Part's identifier, followed for a RAM kit or a drive by `:` and its quantity, a whole number from 1 to 16 in Western digits, repeated for each Part. A Part the catalog does not hold is left out of the Build. Refused, naming `part`, for a value that is not an identifier; a quantity on a Part that is not a RAM kit or a drive, or none on one that is; a quantity outside 1 to 16; two Parts of a Category a Build holds one of; one Part given twice; and more than 8 different RAM kits, or more than 8 different drives. Also refused, naming `part`, with the reason `empty`, for a Build that holds no Part once those the catalog does not hold are left out.

id.description: The Shared Build's identifier, a random UUID, which the Shared Build page's address names.

sharedAt.description: When the Build was first shared, by the API's clock.

id.description: The Shared Build's identifier, a random UUID.

sharedAt.description: When the Build was first shared, by the API's clock.

part.description: The Build's Parts and quantities as they were shared, never changed since, as `GET v1/build` takes them in `part`: lower-case identifiers, in the catalog's order of Categories, then the Build's order for RAM kits and drives, each kit or drive followed by `:` and its quantity. A Part that has left the catalog since stays among them, and `GET v1/build` leaves it out.

vendorId.description: The identifier of the Vendor the Shared Build is sent to: an active Vendor that gave a WhatsApp number. Refused, naming `vendorId`, with the reason `noWhatsAppNumber`, for a Vendor that gave none.

id.description: The Vendor's identifier on the platform.

name.description: The Vendor's name, as the Vendor writes it.

whatsAppNumber.description: The Vendor's WhatsApp number, which the chat is opened with.

referredAt.description: When the Referral was recorded, by the API's clock.

id.description: The Vendor's identifier on the platform.

name.description: The Vendor's name, as the Vendor writes it.

active.description: Whether the Vendor is active, or a deactivated Vendor.

count.description: How many Referrals name the Vendor, over all time.

pageSize.description: How many items a page holds.

totalElements.description: How many items were found, on all the pages together.

first.description: Whether this is the first page.

last.description: Whether this is the last page, or past it.

content.description: The page's Vendors, active and deactivated, those with none among them: the most Referrals first, then by name, then by identifier.

count.description: How many Referrals name the Vendor, over all time.
